action_summary: Pins the divergence between the two front entry points on the owner's charge that the system cannot count different things. canonical/runtime/live_brain_route_admission_v1.solve reconciles the asked quantity (answer_shape_v1.lift_named_answer) and is 9 of 9 correct including 0 for a file with no functions and 9 function NAMES for list-the-functions. canonical/runtime/live_integrated_brain_v1.run_raw_goal never received that reconciliation and is 2 of 9: it returns python_source_definition_count's answer field, total = functions + classes, so it is right if and only if the quantity asked equals the sum. That is why the published INSTANT_LEARNING_PROOF demo passes -- solve_v1.py is 9 functions + 0 classes -- and why astra_runtime.py answers 155 to a question about classes (truth 2). No runtime file is modified; the disagreement is pinned so it cannot be published as capability.
